"""Run the original-resolution double-slit inverse and animate the resulting wave."""

import argparse
import math
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import torch
from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation, PillowWriter
from matplotlib.colors import hsv_to_rgb
from matplotlib.image import AxesImage

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    response,
)

from .model import DEGREE, GRID, REAL
from .workflow import Result, run

FRAMES = 60
FPS = 30


def normalized_field(wave: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    highest = wave[wave.abs().argmax()]
    return (wave * highest.conj() / highest.abs()).reshape(GRID, GRID)


def color_field(wave: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    phase = normalized_field(wave)
    scaled = (phase.abs() / torch.quantile(phase.abs(), 0.5)).tanh()
    hue = (torch.angle(phase) / (2 * math.pi)).remainder(1)
    hsv = torch.stack((hue, torch.full_like(hue, 0.85), scaled / scaled.max()), dim=-1)
    return torch.as_tensor(hsv_to_rgb(hsv.numpy()), dtype=REAL)


def print_report(result: Result) -> None:
    print("Grid points and QSVT degree:", GRID**2, DEGREE)
    print("Phase count:", result.inverse.phases.phases.numel())
    print(
        "Angular frequency, matrix diagonal and normalization:",
        result.model.omega,
        result.model.diagonal,
        result.model.alpha,
    )
    print(
        "Minimum and maximum singular values:",
        result.inverse.minimum_sigma,
        result.inverse.maximum_sigma,
    )
    print("Phase response residual:", result.inverse.phases.residual)
    print(
        "SVD and native fidelities:", result.inverse.expected_fidelity, result.fidelity
    )
    print("Postselection probability:", result.selected_probability)
    print(
        "Full and spectral absolute errors:", result.full_error, result.spectral_error
    )
    print("Workspace probability:", result.work_probability)
    print(
        "Simulator resources:",
        result.resources.n_qubits,
        result.resources.n_operations,
        result.resources.depth,
        result.resources.max_operation_width,
    )
    print("Animation frames and nominal FPS:", FRAMES, FPS)


def save_figures(result: Result, directory: Path) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.2), layout="constrained")
    x = torch.linspace(0, result.inverse.maximum_sigma, 2000, dtype=REAL)
    valid = x[x >= result.inverse.minimum_sigma]
    axis.plot(
        x.tolist(),
        response(x, result.inverse.phases.phases).tolist(),
        label="Fresh degree-191 response",
    )
    target = 0.75 * result.inverse.minimum_sigma / valid
    axis.plot(valid.tolist(), target.tolist(), "--", label="Scaled reciprocal")
    axis.axvline(
        result.inverse.minimum_sigma,
        linestyle=":",
        color="0.35",
        label="Minimum singular value",
    )
    axis.set(
        xlabel="Singular value",
        ylabel="Encoded response",
        title="Inverse polynomial for the 16 × 16 wave grid",
    )
    axis.legend()
    figure.savefig(directory / "inverse-poly.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)

    figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8.8, 4.8), layout="constrained")
    for panel, wave, label in zip(
        axes,
        (result.model.reference, result.wave),
        ("Independent physical solve", "FlagQuantum postselection"),
        strict=True,
    ):
        panel.imshow(color_field(wave), origin="lower", interpolation="nearest")
        panel.set(xlabel="Grid y", ylabel="Grid x", title=label)
    figure.suptitle("Double-slit wave field")
    figure.savefig(directory / "wave-fields.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)


def save_animation(result: Result, directory: Path) -> None:
    wave = normalized_field(result.wave)
    level = torch.quantile(wave.abs(), 0.7)
    figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.8, 4.8), layout="constrained")
    image = axis.imshow(
        (wave.real / level).tanh(),
        origin="lower",
        aspect="equal",
        cmap="twilight",
        vmin=-1,
        vmax=1,
        interpolation="nearest",
    )
    axis.set(
        xlabel="Grid y", ylabel="Grid x", title="Real part of the postselected wave"
    )

    def update(frame: int) -> tuple[AxesImage]:
        angle = -2 * math.pi * frame / FRAMES
        rotation = complex(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
        image.set_data(((wave * rotation).real / level).tanh())
        return (image,)

    animation = FuncAnimation(
        figure, update, frames=range(FRAMES), interval=1000 / FPS, blit=False
    )
    animation.save(directory / "wave-cycle.gif", writer=PillowWriter(fps=FPS), dpi=95)
    plt.close(figure)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--figures", type=Path, default=Path("double-slit-figures"))
    options = parser.parse_args()
    result = run()
    print_report(result)
    save_figures(result, options.figures)
    save_animation(result, options.figures)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Verify full-state wave interference and the independent spectral solution."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from flagquantum.compiler import ResourceEstimate, estimate_resources

from .model import Inverse, Model, build_model, fidelity, inverse_fit
from .quantum import WIDTH, qsvt_circuit
from .reference import complete_state


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    model: Model
    inverse: Inverse
    wave: torch.Tensor
    full_error: float
    spectral_error: float
    work_probability: float
    selected_probability: float
    fidelity: float
    resources: ResourceEstimate


def run() -> Result:
    model = build_model()
    inverse = inverse_fit(model)
    circuit = qsvt_circuit(model, inverse)
    resource = estimate_resources(circuit)
    if resource.n_qubits != WIDTH or resource.max_operation_width > 7:
        raise ValueError("The double-slit program must respect the source width bound")
    if resource.n_operations > 10_000:
        raise ValueError("The bounded simulator instruction budget was exceeded")
    native: torch.Tensor = circuit.state().reshape(1 << 15, 8)
    expected = complete_state(model, inverse)
    full_error = float((native[:, 0] - expected).abs().max())
    work_probability = float(native[:, 1:].abs().square().sum())
    wave = native[:256, 0]
    # The alternating odd QSP convention contributes (-1)^((191-1)/2).
    spectral_error = float((wave + inverse.expected_solution).abs().max())
    success = float(wave.abs().square().sum())
    measured = fidelity(wave, model.reference)
    if max(full_error, spectral_error) > 1e-10 or work_probability > 1e-24:
        raise ValueError(
            "The full physical state disagrees with its tensor or spectral reference"
        )
    if measured < 0.95:
        raise ValueError("The current circuit did not meet the original wave fidelity")
    return Result(
        model,
        inverse,
        wave,
        full_error,
        spectral_error,
        work_probability,
        success,
        measured,
        resource,
    )

"""Regenerate the original 16-by-16 absorbing wave model and inverse polynomial."""

import cmath
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    PhaseFit,
    fit,
    response,
)

GRID = 16
DATA_SIZE = GRID**2
DEGREE = 191
REAL = torch.float64
COMPLEX = torch.complex128
SOURCES = ((8, 2), (7, 2))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Model:
    matrix: torch.Tensor
    source: torch.Tensor
    reference: torch.Tensor
    omega: float
    diagonal: float
    alpha: float
    absorb_phase: float
    selector_amplitudes: tuple[float, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Inverse:
    coefficients: torch.Tensor
    phases: PhaseFit
    minimum_sigma: float
    maximum_sigma: float
    expected_solution: torch.Tensor
    expected_fidelity: float


def build_model() -> Model:
    omega = 6 * math.pi / GRID
    diagonal = omega**2 - 4
    alpha = 4 + 3 * abs(diagonal)
    absorption = (1 + 0.5j * omega) / (-1 + 0.5j * omega)
    boundary_weight = torch.tensor(diagonal * absorption, dtype=COMPLEX)
    matrix = torch.zeros(DATA_SIZE, DATA_SIZE, dtype=COMPLEX)
    for x in range(GRID):
        for y in range(GRID):
            row = x * GRID + y
            boundary_x = x in (0, GRID - 1)
            boundary_y = y in (0, GRID - 1)
            if boundary_x and not boundary_y:
                matrix[row, (1 if x == 0 else GRID - 2) * GRID + y] = boundary_weight
            elif boundary_y and not boundary_x:
                matrix[row, x * GRID + (1 if y == 0 else GRID - 2)] = boundary_weight
            elif not boundary_x and not boundary_y:
                for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    matrix[row, (x + dx) * GRID + y + dy] = 1
    barriers = [
        x * GRID + y for x in range(GRID) if (x >> 1) not in (2, 5) for y in (6, 7)
    ]
    matrix[barriers, :] = 0
    matrix[:, barriers] = 0
    matrix += diagonal * torch.eye(DATA_SIZE, dtype=COMPLEX)
    source = torch.zeros(DATA_SIZE, dtype=COMPLEX)
    for x, y in SOURCES:
        source[x * GRID + y] = 1 / math.sqrt(2)
    reference = torch.linalg.solve(matrix, source)
    probabilities = (4.0, 2 * abs(diagonal), abs(diagonal), 0.0)
    return Model(
        matrix,
        source,
        reference,
        omega,
        diagonal,
        alpha,
        cmath.phase(-absorption),
        tuple(math.sqrt(weight / alpha) for weight in probabilities),
    )


def fidelity(left: torch.Tensor, right: torch.Tensor) -> float:
    similarity = float(torch.vdot(left, right).abs() / (left.norm() * right.norm()))
    return similarity**2


def chebyshev(value: torch.Tensor, degree: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Evaluate T on the real line, including the source mapping outside [-1, 1]."""
    previous, current = torch.ones_like(value), value
    for _ in range(1, degree):
        previous, current = current, 2 * value * current - previous
    return current


def inverse_fit(model: Model) -> Inverse:
    u, sigma, vh = torch.linalg.svd(model.matrix / model.alpha)
    minimum = float(sigma[-1])
    angles = math.pi * (torch.arange(DEGREE + 1, dtype=REAL) + 0.5) / (DEGREE + 1)
    x = angles.cos()
    offset = 1 + minimum**2
    scale = 1 - minimum**2
    degree = (DEGREE + 1) // 2
    signal = (2 * x.square() - offset) / scale
    denominator = chebyshev(torch.tensor(-offset / scale, dtype=REAL), degree)
    values = 0.75 * minimum * (1 - chebyshev(signal, degree) / denominator) / x
    orders = torch.arange(1, DEGREE + 1, 2, dtype=REAL)
    coefficients = (2 / angles.numel()) * torch.cos(angles[:, None] * orders).T @ values
    phases = fit(coefficients)
    expected = vh.mH @ (response(sigma, phases.phases) * (u.mH @ model.source))
    overlap = fidelity(expected, model.reference)
    if overlap < 0.95:
        raise ValueError("The original wave solution missed its SVD fidelity target")
    return Inverse(coefficients, phases, minimum, float(sigma[0]), expected, overlap)

"""Fit odd symmetric QSP phases to a fresh Chebyshev series."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

DTYPE = torch.float64
CTYPE = torch.complex128


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PhaseFit:
    phases: torch.Tensor
    residual: float
    iterations: int


def signal(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = x.to(CTYPE)
    y = 1j * (1 - x.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
    return torch.stack((w, y, y, w), dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2, 2)


def values_and_derivative(
    w: torch.Tensor, half: torch.Tensor
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rotation = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * half).exp(), (-1j * half).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    product = [rotation[j] @ w for j in range(half.numel())]
    product[-1] = rotation[-1].expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    identity = torch.eye(2, dtype=CTYPE).expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    prefix = [identity]
    for factor in product:
        prefix.append(prefix[-1] @ factor)
    left = prefix[-1]
    right = w @ left.transpose(-1, -2)
    result = (left @ right)[:, 0, 0].imag
    deriv = []
    suffix = right
    generator = torch.diag(torch.tensor([1j, -1j], dtype=CTYPE))
    for j in range(half.numel() - 1, -1, -1):
        suffix = product[j] @ suffix
        deriv.append(2 * (prefix[j] @ generator @ suffix)[:, 0, 0].imag)
    return result, torch.stack(list(reversed(deriv)), dim=1)


def response(x: torch.Tensor, angles: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = signal(x)
    phases = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * angles).exp(), (-1j * angles).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    out = phases[0]
    for rotation in phases[1:]:
        out = out @ w @ rotation
    value: torch.Tensor = out[:, 0, 0].imag
    return value


def fit(coefficients: torch.Tensor) -> PhaseFit:
    extent = coefficients.numel()
    nodes = math.pi * (torch.arange(extent, dtype=DTYPE) + 0.5) / (2 * extent)
    orders = torch.arange(1, 2 * extent, 2, dtype=DTYPE)
    w = signal(torch.cos(nodes))
    target = torch.cos(nodes[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients
    theta = torch.zeros_like(orders)
    iteration = 0
    while iteration < 12:
        samples, jacobian = values_and_derivative(w, theta)
        residual = target - samples
        if float(residual.abs().max()) < 1e-12:
            break
        theta += torch.linalg.solve(jacobian, residual)
        iteration += 1
    physical = torch.cat((theta, theta.flip((0,))))
    angles = torch.linspace(0, math.pi, 4097, dtype=DTYPE)
    x = angles.cos()
    error = float(
        (response(x, physical) - torch.cos(angles[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients)
        .abs()
        .max()
    )
    if error >= 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("The fresh QSP sequence must verify on the dense grid")
    return PhaseFit(physical, error, iteration)

"""Compose the 18-qubit inverse with small, exact reversible simulator blocks."""

import math
from collections.abc import Callable

import torch

import flagquantum as fq

from .model import COMPLEX, DEGREE, REAL, Inverse, Model

AUX = 0
SELECT = (1, 2)
AXIS, DIRECTION, SCATTER, EDGE = 3, 4, 5, 6
X = (7, 8, 9, 10)
Y = (11, 12, 13, 14)
WORK = (15, 16, 17)
WIDTH = 18


def permutation(width: int, move: Callable[[int], int]) -> torch.Tensor:
    dimension = 1 << width
    columns = torch.arange(dimension)
    rows = torch.tensor([move(word) for word in range(dimension)])
    if (
        torch.unique(rows).numel() != dimension
        or int(rows.min()) != 0
        or int(rows.max()) != dimension - 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("A circuit permutation must be bijective")
    operator = torch.zeros(dimension, dimension, dtype=COMPLEX)
    operator[rows, columns] = 1
    return operator


def toggle(
    circuit: fq.Circuit,
    inputs: tuple[int, ...],
    target: int,
    predicate: Callable[[int], bool],
) -> None:
    """XOR a reversible predicate into its separate target bit."""
    circuit.any(
        *inputs,
        target,
        matrix=permutation(
            len(inputs) + 1, lambda word: word ^ int(predicate(word >> 1))
        )
    )


def zero_or_max(circuit: fq.Circuit, data: tuple[int, ...], target: int) -> None:
    toggle(circuit, data, target, lambda word: word in (0, 15))


def scatterer(circuit: fq.Circuit, target: int) -> None:
    toggle(
        circuit,
        (*X[:3], *Y[:3]),
        target,
        lambda word: word >> 3 not in (2, 5) and word % 8 == 3,
    )


def shift(circuit: fq.Circuit, data: tuple[int, ...], axis: int, enable: int) -> None:
    def move(word: int) -> int:
        if word >> 6 and (word >> 5) & 1 == axis:
            delta = -1 if (word >> 4) & 1 else 1
            return (word & ~15) | ((word + delta) % 16)
        return word

    circuit.any(enable, AXIS, DIRECTION, *data, matrix=permutation(7, move))


def laplacian(circuit: fq.Circuit) -> None:
    enable, scratch, flag = WORK
    toggle(circuit, SELECT, enable, lambda word: word == 0)
    scatterer(circuit, scratch)
    circuit.ccx(enable, scratch, SCATTER)
    scatterer(circuit, scratch)
    circuit.ch(enable, AXIS).ch(enable, DIRECTION)
    shift(circuit, X, 0, enable)
    shift(circuit, Y, 1, enable)
    circuit.ch(enable, DIRECTION).ch(enable, AXIS)
    toggle(circuit, SELECT, enable, lambda word: word == 0)

    zero_or_max(circuit, X, enable)
    zero_or_max(circuit, Y, scratch)
    scatterer(circuit, flag)
    toggle(circuit, (*SELECT, *WORK), EDGE, lambda word: 0 < word < 8)
    scatterer(circuit, flag)
    zero_or_max(circuit, Y, scratch)
    zero_or_max(circuit, X, enable)


def absorbing_axis(
    circuit: fq.Circuit, select: int, axis: int, data: tuple[int, ...]
) -> None:
    condition = 2 + axis
    toggle(circuit, (select, AXIS), data[-1], lambda word: word == condition)
    toggle(
        circuit,
        (select, AXIS, *data),
        DIRECTION,
        lambda word: word >> 4 == condition and word % 16 not in (0, 15),
    )


def absorbing_boundary(circuit: fq.Circuit) -> None:
    select, scratch, _ = WORK
    toggle(circuit, SELECT, select, lambda word: word == 1)
    circuit.ch(select, AXIS)
    absorbing_axis(circuit, select, 0, X)
    absorbing_axis(circuit, select, 1, Y)
    circuit.ch(select, AXIS)
    for data in (X, Y):
        zero_or_max(circuit, data, scratch)
        circuit.ccx(select, scratch, SCATTER)
        zero_or_max(circuit, data, scratch)
    circuit.cx(select, SCATTER)
    toggle(circuit, SELECT, select, lambda word: word == 1)


def selector(weights: tuple[float, ...]) -> fq.Circuit:
    a, b, c, d = weights
    prep = fq.Circuit(2, dtype=COMPLEX).ry(
        0, 2 * math.atan2(math.hypot(c, d), math.hypot(a, b))
    )
    prep.x(0).cry(0, 1, theta=2 * math.atan2(b, a)).x(0)
    if d:
        prep.cry(0, 1, theta=2 * math.atan2(d, c))
    return prep


def signal(model: Model) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Use three clean scratch bits for the selector, scatterer and boundary OR."""
    prep = selector(model.selector_amplitudes)
    circuit = fq.Circuit(WIDTH, dtype=COMPLEX).compose(prep, qubits=SELECT)
    laplacian(circuit)
    absorbing_boundary(circuit)
    values = torch.tensor((0, model.absorb_phase, math.pi, 0), dtype=REAL)
    circuit.any(*SELECT, matrix=torch.diag((1j * values).exp()))
    return circuit.compose(prep.adjoint(), qubits=SELECT)


def projector(angle: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Apply the projected RZ phase to the two interferometer branches."""
    words = torch.arange(128)
    positive = ((words & 63) == 0) == ((words >> 6) == 0)
    return torch.diag((1j * angle * (2 * positive.to(REAL) - 1)).exp())


def qsvt_circuit(model: Model, inverse: Inverse) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Preserve all 191 signal calls and the source's original width limit."""
    angles = inverse.phases.phases - math.pi / 2
    angles[0] += math.pi / 4
    angles[-1] += math.pi / 4
    if angles.numel() != DEGREE + 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly 192 inverse angles")
    block = signal(model)
    adjoint = block.adjoint()
    circuit = fq.Circuit(WIDTH, dtype=COMPLEX)
    circuit.x(X[-1]).x(X[-2]).x(X[-3]).x(Y[-2])
    circuit.h(X[0])
    for wire in X[1:]:
        circuit.cx(X[0], wire)
    circuit.h(AUX)
    phase_wires = tuple(range(7))
    circuit.any(*phase_wires, matrix=projector(float(angles[0])))
    for index, angle in enumerate(angles[1:]):
        circuit.compose(adjoint if index % 2 == 0 else block)
        circuit.any(*phase_wires, matrix=projector(float(angle)))
    return circuit.h(AUX)
